Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 10264 -1982 




Indian Standard 



( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 



SPECIFICATION FOR 

TROLLEY, HOT FOOD, FOR HOSPITAL 

AND INDUSTRIAL CANTEENS 



1. Scope — This standard prescribes the requirements for shelves type hot food trolley used for 
hospitals and catering establishments for carrying food in warm conditions. 

2. Material 

2.1 Steel Angles for frame — Structural steel as per IS : 226-1975 'Specification for structural steel 
(standard quality) ( fifth revision ) \ 

2.2 Inside Pa/?e/s — Aluminium or stainless steel as per 13:737-1974 'Specification for wrought 
aluminium and aluminium alloys, sheet and strip (for general engmeering purposes) ( second rei^/s/o/? ) ' 
or IS : 6911-1972 'Specification for stainless steel plate sheet and strip ' respectively. 

2.3 Outside Panels — Mild steel, stainless steel or aluminium as per the relevant Indian Standards. 

2.4 Glass wool of minimum 25 mm thickness. 

2.5 Cas/ors— Conforming to IS: 4034-1979 ' Specification for castors for hospital equipment' 
{first revision), 

2.6 Handles — Aluminium or stainless steel as per the relevant Indian Standards. 

2.7 Shelves — Aluminium or stainless steel as per the relevant Indian Standards. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 

915 



610- 



1170

THERMOSTAT- 




*5ee IS ; 3034-1979 Castors for hospital equipment ( first revision ).

FIG. 1 TROLLEY, HOT FOOD, TRAY TYPE 

4. Manufacture 

4,1 Wancf/es — Handles of suitable shape and size shall be provided for manoeuverability.

IS: 10264-1982 

4.2 Frame — Theirame shall be rigid and sturdy in construction, 

4-3 Insulation — All four sides and top shall be suitably insulated with 25 mm glass wool. 

4.4 The trolley shall be provided with shelves as per the requirement of the purchaser. The shelves 
shall be adjustable. 

4.5 Electrical ioad — Suitable electrical heating elements (See IS : 4159-1976 ' Specification for mineral 
filled sheathred heating elements (first revision )' shall be fitted at a suitable place for heating and 
covered with protective sheet. Protective sheet shall be of the same materials as the Inside panels. A 
flexible cord with 15/piug shall be provided with the equipment. The plug shall be in accordance with 
IS : 1293-1967 ' Specification for three-pin plugs and socket-outlets (first revision ) '. 

4.6 The trolley shall satisfy the safety requirements as per IS : 302-1979 ' General and safety requirements 
for household and similar electrical appliances (fifth revision)'. In addition the trolley shall befitted 
with bumper guards for protection against shock. 

4.7 Door — Doors shall be insulated from inside like the main body. 

4.8 Thermostat — A bimetallic thermostat shall be provided inside the trolley to maintain the temperature 
at SO^C or the desired temperature. The thermostat shall satisfy the requirements as per IS : 4165-1967 
' Specification for thermostat for general purpose electric ovens', 

4.9 Two indicating lamps shall be provided, one to indicate the ' Mains On ' and other for the ' Heaters 
On'. 

5. instruction Manual — An instruction manual shall be provided with each equipment indicating in 
detail the operation and maintenance of the equipment. 

6. Marking — Each trolley shall have a name plate or label affixed to it showing the manufacturer's 
name, initials or recognized trade-mark, type of trolley and electric rating. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

7. Packing — As agreed to between the manufacturer and the purchaser. 



Printed at Arcee Press. New Delhi, India
